plotSections.title: Exhaustion plan and remedies
bullets: Walker commits to 49 days at five dragon energy per day, totaling 245 energy and one exhaustion level per day for his entire Reach stay.
The DM confirms he will have disadvantage on ability checks throughout the trip unless he changes course.
Dragon-rider exhaustion has no easy cure except labor-intensive potions or cleric/paladin magic; Dana and Ord are not with him.
Elrus cannot cure Walker’s exhaustion daily.
Nicotine can help short-term but causes severe withdrawal without supply; Walker makes a mental note to acquire it after giving up alcohol.

plotSections.title: Detour to Sunder and group split
bullets: Walker plans to fly with Elrus and Plymouth toward the training grounds, routing over Sunder to shop for exhaustion relief.
The DM agrees Sunder may carry exhaustion potions and other rare supplies.
Elrus declines supplies, says he dislikes frequenting Sunder, and will meet Walker in the mountains with Araden.
Plymouth flies into Sunder with Walker while Elrus and Araden head for the mountains.

plotSections.title: Communication while separated
bullets: Walker tells Ciri mind-link communication is open, though the DM notes mind chat is likely out of range without a spell.
Elrus’s dragon could use fire bursts as a signal.
Elrus and Plymouth teach Walker rudimentary fire signals equivalent to SOS: several short flame bursts, one long burst, then several short bursts.
Walker has not learned full fire or flag signaling; he can now recognize basic SOS and a few simple flag communique, but not as a proficiency.
Dragon-rider guild flags exist for ground observers to signal riders, not for riders to signal others.

plotSections.title: Arrival in Sunder
bullets: Sunder is a floating amalgamation of towers and islands in The Reach.
Named districts include Haven Hold at the center, the Bronze Palace, the Bronze Arena, Miss Mary’s, the docks, the Prancing Fox, and Louise Casino.
The Haven likely has exhaustion potions and magic items, some tied to completing another Sunder Chase circuit.
A dragon’s hoard serves as Haven Hold’s hoard, enchanted by Benji and that dragon so racers may pick from it before running the circuit.
The dock quarter has shops; Calypso runs a vending operation that drifts between Miss Mary’s and the dock corridor.
On landing, Walker draws fewer stares than usual for a dragon rider; the docks teem with griffins, giant eagles, flying ships, and a diverse market crowd.
Plymouth is eager to visit several areas he has been eyeing.

plotSections.title: Shopping goals
bullets: Walker wants potions or magic items to offset daily exhaustion, with nicotine as a fallback.
Plymouth seeks horn root, powdered dragon scale, wet alchemical items, and a dragon gizzard for spell components.
Plymouth says greater restoration can cure exhaustion effects and a rare potion of vitality can remove all exhaustion-related ailments, though both are expensive in Sunder.
They run Plymouth’s street-vendor errands first, then enter an apothecary that may have potions for Walker and gizzard for Plymouth.

chronologicalEvents: Walker finalizes spending 245 dragon energy over 49 days at one exhaustion level per day.
The DM confirms Walker will operate at disadvantage on ability checks for his Reach stay.
The DM explains exhaustion remedies are limited to potions or cleric/paladin aid.
Walker learns Elrus cannot cure his daily exhaustion.
The DM describes nicotine as a short-term aid with harsh withdrawal; Walker notes he should get nicotine.
Walker commits to the exhaustion plan and prepares to fly with Elrus and Plymouth.
Walker proposes a detour stop in Sunder for exhaustion potions and supplies.
Elrus declines supplies, says he dislikes visiting Sunder often, and agrees to meet in the mountains.
Walker offers Elrus jerky and salt leaf; Elrus declines.
Walker opens mind-link communication with Ciri for the separated group.
Elrus and Plymouth teach Walker basic SOS fire signals and simple flag recognition.
Elrus and Araden fly to the mountains; Plymouth accompanies Walker into Sunder.
Walker and Plymouth arrive in the floating city of Sunder.
The DM describes Sunder’s districts, the Haven Hold dragon hoard prize tied to Sunder Chase, and Calypso’s vending route.
Walker and Plymouth discuss their separate shopping goals.
Plymouth recommends greater restoration or a rare potion of vitality for exhaustion.
They shop street vendors for Plymouth’s ingredients, then enter an apothecary.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Plans 49 days in The Reach at five dragon energy per day, accepting one exhaustion level daily.
Is roleplaying cumulative tiredness from expending energy into his magical gems.
Seeks potions or magic items in Sunder to offset exhaustion, with nicotine as a backup plan.
Learns basic SOS fire signals and simple flag-communique recognition, but not as a proficiency.
Usually relies on mind messages from Dana rather than traditional dragon-rider signaling.
personality: Pragmatic about enduring exhaustion for the mission.
Recently gave up alcohol and is looking for a replacement vice.
quotesThemes: I'm here for items or potions or anything to help me with just being tired.

Plymouth Gawater.existing: Gnome artificer and party ally who guides the new keepers.
notes: Flies into Sunder with Walker while Elrus and Araden head for the mountains.
Wants horn root, powdered dragon scale, wet alchemical items, and a dragon gizzard for spell components.
Knows Sunder’s market well enough to lead Walker through street vendors to an apothecary.
Recommends greater restoration or a rare potion of vitality for Walker’s exhaustion.
personality: Talkative and eager in the Sunder market.
Knowledgeable about alchemical supplies and exhaustion remedies.

Elrus.existing: Walker's hidden ally in the coming confrontation.
notes: Cannot cure Walker’s daily exhaustion.
Dislikes frequenting Sunder and declines supply purchases.
Helps teach Walker rudimentary fire signals before splitting off.
Flies to the mountains with Araden to rendezvous later.

Araden.existing: A magically capable companion brought secretly to The Reach.
notes: Flies with Elrus to the mountains while Walker and Plymouth enter Sunder.
A floating amalgamation of towers and islands in The Reach.
Contains Haven Hold, the Bronze Palace, the Bronze Arena, Miss Mary’s, the docks, the Prancing Fox, and Louise Casino.
Has shops with rare supplies including possible exhaustion potions, horn root, dragon scale powder, and dragon gizzard.
Some magic items require investigative work and completing another Sunder Chase circuit to obtain.
Completing another circuit of the Sunder Chase may be required to obtain certain magic items in the Haven.
Haven Hold’s dragon hoard is set up as a pre-race prize pick before running the circuit.

Benji.existing: Benji is familiar with The Reach and may be at the party's bar.
notes: Worked with the Haven Hold dragon to enchant its hoard as the penultimate Sunder Chase prize.
Named vendor in Sunder with a floating vending operation.
Drifts between Miss Mary’s and the dock corridor.
The party has had slight prior interactions with her.
Uses mind-link communication better than Walker while he is away.
Stays in contact with the separated group; mind chat may be out of range without a spell.
Not present with Walker; her cleric magic could help with exhaustion.
Walker usually receives short mind messages from her while flying rather than using flags or fire signals.
